title: Congruence of Triangles
description: Class 7 IMO — Congruence of triangles: congruence of figures and line segments, the SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS criteria, and writing correct congruence statements.

topics.title: Congruence of Figures
topics.concept: Two figures are congruent if they have exactly the same shape and size. The symbol for congruence is ≅. Two line segments are congruent if they have the same length, and two angles are congruent if they have the same measure.

examples.problem: When are two line segments congruent?
examples.solution: When they have the same length.

quiz.q: Two squares are congruent if their ___ are equal.
quiz.explanation: Equal sides make the squares the same size and shape.

topics.title: Congruence Criteria (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS)
topics.concept: Triangles are congruent if: all three sides match (SSS); two sides and the included angle match (SAS); two angles and the included side match (ASA); or, in right triangles, the right angle, hypotenuse and one side match (RHS).

examples.problem: Which criterion uses three equal sides?
Which criterion uses a right angle, the hypotenuse and one side?

recap: SSS, SAS, ASA work for all triangles; RHS for right triangles.
SSA is NOT a valid criterion.

quiz.q: Two sides and the included angle equal — which criterion?
quiz.explanation: Two sides and the included angle is SAS.

quiz.q: Two angles and the included side equal — which criterion?
quiz.explanation: Two angles and the included side is ASA.

topics.title: Correspondence & Congruence Statements
topics.concept: The order of letters in a congruence statement shows which parts match. If △ABC ≅ △DEF, then A matches D, B matches E and C matches F, so side AB corresponds to DE and angle A equals angle D.

examples.problem: If △ABC ≅ △DEF, which side corresponds to AB?
If △ABC ≅ △DEF, angle A equals which angle?

recap: The order of letters gives the correspondence.
Matching sides and angles are equal.

quiz.explanation: B matches Q and C matches R, so BC corresponds to QR.
Congruent triangles are identical, so their areas are equal.

questions.q: Which criterion uses three equal sides?
RHS applies to which kind of triangles?
Congruent figures have the same shape and ___ ?
questions.explanation: Congruent figures have the same shape and size.

questions.q: Three equal sides make two triangles congruent by ___ ?
Two sides and the included angle equal — which criterion?
questions.explanation: Two sides and the included angle — SAS.

questions.q: Two angles and the included side equal — which criterion?
questions.explanation: Two angles and the included side — ASA.
A matches D and B matches E, so AB corresponds to DE.
B matches Q, so angle B = angle Q.

questions.q: Two line segments are congruent if they have the same ___ ?
questions.explanation: Congruent segments have the same length.
Same shape and size means congruent.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a valid congruence criterion?
questions.explanation: SSA is not a valid congruence criterion.

questions.q: If △ABC ≅ △DEF and AB = 5 cm, then DE = ___ ?
questions.explanation: Corresponding sides are equal, so DE = 5 cm.

questions.q: Two right triangles with equal hypotenuse and one equal side are congruent by ___ ?
questions.explanation: Right angle, hypotenuse and side — RHS.
